content.title: Eaton 401-3153 PTFE Hose, 1-Wire Braid, SAE 100R14, 13.4 mm OD
content.short_description: Eaton 401-3153 is a 1-wire braid PTFE hose built to SAE 100R14, with a 13.4 mm outer diameter and a rated temperature range of -73°C to +232°C.
content.long_description:
Eaton 401-3153 is a PTFE tube hose reinforced with a single wire braid layer, manufactured to the SAE 100R14 specification. The PTFE tube provides chemical resistance suited to fluid transfer lines where compatibility with aggressive media and high temperatures is required.

The hose has an outer diameter of 13.4 mm and an operating temperature range of -73°C to +232°C, allowing use in both cryogenic and high-heat service conditions. The 1-wire braid reinforcement provides structural support for the PTFE tube under system pressure.

This part is designated for fluid handling applications where SAE 100R14 compliance is specified. Confirm inner diameter, working pressure rating, and fitting compatibility against system requirements before installation.
